title: 16-Inch Triple Tier Wall-Mount Glass Shelf With Solid Brass Hardware | Oil Rubbed Bronze | Allied Brass
body_html:
Clear the countertop and keep everyday essentials easy to find with a triple tier wall-mount glass shelf sized for bathroom vanities in Oil Rubbed Bronze, which offers rich, dark brown tones with subtle copper highlights, bringing Old World character to any bathroom.

  • Oil Rubbed Bronze brings rich depth and character
  • Choose from 28 designer finishes to match the rest of your bathroom
  • Clean, modern look: Concealed screw mounting keeps hardware discreet for minimalist bathroom fixtures.
  • Coordinate your decor: Designed to complement modern bathroom hardware and contemporary bath accessories.

Specs & Installation

  • Glass dimensions: 16 x 5 inches
  • Overall dimensions: 16 in L x 5 in W x 15 in H
  • Glass thickness: 0.38 in (3/8 in)
  • Weight capacity: 6 lb
  • Mounting: wall mount with concealed screws (screw size: #8 x 1 1/4)
  • Assembly required: No
  • Included: Glass shelf and all installation hardware
  • Warranty: Limited Lifetime Warranty

_previous.description: Add space and organization to your bathroom with this simple, contemporary design 3-tier glass vanity shelf. Featuring tempered, beveled-edged glass and solid brass hardware this shelving unit is crafted for durability, strength and style. One of the many coordinating accessories in the Allied Brass collection of products, this subtle glass shelf unit is the perfect complement to your bathroom decor.
